item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8-seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 8 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a clean, energetic 10-second 16:9 widescreen motion-graphics app advertisement for FitTrack using BOTH supplied screenshot references, in the exact specified order. These are actual app UI screenshots: preserve their appearance, proportions, colors and legible text instead of inventing replacement UI. Display the portrait screenshots fully in generous widescreen compositions with white backgrounds, blue and green graphic accents, crisp typography, soft shadows and subtle kinetic motion. No people. Timeline: 0.0–3.7 seconds: show ONLY the home screenshot @home, fully visible as a large portrait app panel centered slightly right, with headline on the left 'Your day. In motion.' Quick clean slide-in, gentle push-in, blue accents. 3.7–7.7 seconds: transition with a snappy horizontal slide to ONLY the workout screenshot @workout, fully visible as a large portrait app panel centered slightly left, with headline on the right 'Make every rep count.' Green accents and restrained rhythmic graphic pulses. 7.7–10.0 seconds: transition to a clean, uncluttered white end card with the exact app name 'FitTrack' in large bold blue type at center and smaller line 'Track today. Build tomorrow.' underneath. Hold the final app name clearly through the end. Professional minimalist fitness brand advertisement, energetic but readable, smooth transitions synced to music, no UI distortion, no extra logos. AUDIO: upbeat modern instrumental beat around 120 BPM, punchy light drums, positive synth bass and bright melodic accents, synced to transitions, clean ending. Absolutely no voiceover, no speech, no singing, no vocals.
